about_text: I have been working with ceramics for many years, and what I enjoy most is making decorative pieces. I am fascinated by how a thing with its own character emerges from a lump of clay. I make each piece by hand in my studio in Brno.
about_page_meta_description: Meet Lada Bartoníková and her handmade ceramics studio in Brno.
about_page_story_text_1: I have been working with ceramics for many years, and what I enjoy most is making decorative pieces - little angels, animals and figures with their own character. I'm fascinated by how a lump of clay becomes something with its own little story.
about_page_story_text_2: I make every piece by hand in my small studio in Brno, from the first shaping to the final glaze. No mass production - that's why every piece is unique, and no two are ever quite the same.
about_page_process_heading: How a piece comes to life
about_page_process_text: It all starts with a sketch and a lump of clay. I shape it by hand, let it dry, fire it twice, and finish it with a chosen glaze. From idea to finished piece usually takes a few days.
